column1: # Self-test cases of IEC 60870-5-102 for scripts/interop.sh, against the
# baseline fixture (fixtures/iec102/baseline), unbalanced, every client with
# every server: the operations of the smoke test's checks against the scripted
# values of the documents with the fixture.
# Columns, separated by tabs, as tests/iec101/cases.tsv:
#   1  id      stable dotted scenario id of results.json (prefixed with
#   2  state   "ro" (servers are shared) or "rw" (a freshly started server)
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, confirmations (cause, "n" when
#              negative), termination, and type/cause of every received ASDU
#   5  needs   "-", or "server:<feature>" and "client:<feature>", separated by commas
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# The access key of the fixture is 7. The REE operations run in a session: the
# mirrors of C_AC_NA_2 and C_FS_NA_2 are in the ASDUs. A wrong key is refused
# with the P/N bit (cause 7, the summary shows the cause only) and nothing else
# is sent. set-time changes the station's clock, so it gets a server of its own.
